feeds.title: Today's Catholic
feeds.description: Get local News, updates, and announcements from the Bishop and the Diocese of Fort Wayne. Today's Catholic is a diversified news content delivery brand that includes a website, a digital edition, and an app in addition to the printed newspaper serving the communities of Fort Wayne and South Bend.

feeds.title: The Waynedale News
feeds.description: The Waynedale News is one of the few remaining locally-owned newspapers in Indiana. Here at The Waynedale News, our mission is to sustain, unite and enhance the Waynedale community and surrounding areas. Read breaking news, sports, local events, and area entertainment written by community authors.
